method: Three serial fresh-app pairs for every mode/workload; middle pair order reversed. Allocation/CPU sampling, natural renderer tracing, and ordinary external 100 ms procfs sampling use separate apps. Grammar is fully parsed through EOF before work. Files are tracked in a temporary Git repository. Source/build hashes are checked after each case; no builds, tests, other agent-launched benchmarks or forced production GC during cases. Exact final text and undo/redo verified for every run. All measured app main PIDs are absent after teardown. Raw diagnostic profiles/traces and every accepted/rejected process sample are in the companion gzip archive.
scope: Descriptive medians and all paired differences, not randomized trials or general performance inference. Allocation numbers are 32 KiB sampled weighted estimates including minor/major-collected objects; retrieving a profile forces diagnostic GC after the work markers. Trace numbers are main-thread DevTools GC and V8 ObservablePause event durations in the work window, not an exact universal STW metric. Trace buffers add overhead. Plain mode uses no debugger/profiler/tracer/explicit GC and includes work plus two seconds of settling in separately reported process PSS. Sampled maxima are not continuous peaks; PSS excludes sampler, Xvfb, external services and driver allocations outside app descendants. Synchronous dispatch timings exclude later React commits and paint. No installed Windows/macOS, GPU/VRAM, provider or globally bounded-app-memory claim.
